interpretation: Direct Cirsium manipulations contain both a defensive-benefit context and null contexts, including temporally different evidence for C. discolor. This is expected under the frozen enemy-pressure-by-trait-cost model and is inconsistent with a universal positive defence effect.
claim_boundary: This validation was recovered after S1/S2/S3 were frozen and therefore does not redefine the model set.
The studies are North American Cirsium and are not transported as effect sizes for JPN15 or other East-Asian lineages.
Benefit/null heterogeneity supports context dependence but does not identify which antagonist, secretion cost or pollinator cost generated any Japan38 stickiness transition.
Focal causation still requires within-JPN15 stickiness neutralization with enemy, pollinator and viable-seed endpoints.
